##### Project general facts

ORLA by OMNIYAT is an ultra-luxury beachfront development that redefines bespoke living through a seamless blend of architecture, nature, and refined design. Conceived as a private sanctuary, the project offers an exclusive collection of just 86 residences, 3 sky palaces, and 2 mansions, each crafted to deliver a highly personalized living experience. The architecture emphasizes harmony with natural elements, incorporating flowing water features and lush greenery to create a sense of balance, tranquility, and connection with the surroundings.

The development provides a resort-level lifestyle with expansive landscaped территории, beachfront access, and panoramic 270-degree views spanning Dubai’s skyline and the Arabian Gulf. Positioned at the pinnacle of Palm Jumeirah, ORLA offers privacy and exclusivity while maintaining proximity to the city’s key lifestyle destinations. The project is designed to blur the boundaries between indoor and outdoor living, enhancing both everyday comfort and the overall living experience.

Residences are thoughtfully designed with spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and seamless transitions between interior and exterior spaces. Interiors are finished with premium materials, including Italian travertine and marble, curated by Yodezeen designers. Each unit features a fully equipped kitchen with high-end, professional-grade appliances, while the residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing owners to fully customize their space. ORLA represents a rare opportunity to own a highly exclusive, design-led residence in one of Dubai’s most prestigious waterfront locations.


##### Location description and benefits

Palm Jumeirah, an iconic man-made island in Dubai, is known for its unique palm-tree-shaped design and offers an exclusive lifestyle at the very heart of the Arabian Gulf. It features a combination of luxury villas, apartments, and hotels, making it one of Dubai's most prestigious residential and tourist destinations. With its private beaches, ocean views, and proximity to Dubai Marina, the island attracts those seeking a refined coastal lifestyle in an extraordinary architectural setting.

The area is renowned for its luxurious hospitality options, hosting some of Dubai’s most celebrated hotels and resorts, such as Atlantis The Palm and One&Only. These resorts add to the island's vibrancy with world-class dining, leisure, and entertainment venues that attract visitors and residents alike. Residents benefit from premium amenities, including private beach access, fitness centers, pools, and retail outlets, creating a comprehensive, self-contained living experience.

Palm Jumeirah’s location provides easy access to other major Dubai neighborhoods while maintaining a serene, resort-like environment. The island’s monorail and well-planned road networks facilitate movement within and beyond the island, connecting residents to the vibrant city. This combination of exclusivity, convenience, and scenic beauty makes Palm Jumeirah one of Dubai’s most desirable and well-rounded neighborhoods, offering a lifestyle that feels worlds away yet is intimately connected to the pulse of the city.
